description: Random authorities and fact sets, each with the verdict the Lean model of Part II gives (papers/oracle). An implementation agrees when evaluate(artifact, facts) gives the same verdict, the same deciding rule (rN; null when the default applied) and the same escalation. Covers resolution: Kleene logic, the choice of decider, the SPEC-008 0.5.0 gate, defaults, tie orders and obligations, over the comparisons == != < <= > >=, bare booleans and exists(). A case whose expect is {unevaluable: true} has a ruling no evaluator may read (SPEC-008 §6.0): evaluate() must refuse it, whatever the facts. Reproduce: python3 generate.py 5000 2026 | ../papers/.lake/build/bin/oracle.
